players.product: high-speed current sensors (5 MHz, TMR) for AI server power supplies, fan motor driver ICs and isolated gate drivers for data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: Suppliers UMC, Polar, Tower Semiconductor and TSMC: Allegro's 10-K says it operates as a fabless company for semiconductor wafer fabrication, relying entirely on third-party foundry partners, and currently relies on a limited number of third-party wafer fabrication facilities for the wafers used in its IC products, primarily UMC, Polar, Tower Semiconductor and TSMC (its primary fab partners are listed as UMC, PSL, Tower and TSMC). It has master service agreements with all primary foundry partners, long-term supply agreements with some of them, and take-or-pay agreements with certain wafer fabrication partners requiring it to purchase a minimum number of wafers per year; two of its third-party wafer fabrication facilities are in Taiwan. It is qualifying additional wafer foundries and OSAT partners in Asia. Back-end: its Philippines facility (AMPI) is the primary internal assembly and test site for sensor and power products, supplemented by subcontractors in Asia; approximately 51% of assembly was outsourced in fiscal 2026 (45% in fiscal 2025, 47% in fiscal 2024), and during fiscal 2026 Allegro began shipping to regional customers from additional OSAT partners in Asia.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 51% of assembly outsourced in FY2026 (45% FY2025, 47% FY2024)

quarterly_data.signal: Allegro's 10-K: recent Chinese export restrictions on certain rare-earth elements, metals and magnets, including samarium, used in its applications have disrupted its ability to reliably source materials, and it has encountered shortages and delays in obtaining wafers and other components from time to time.

Allegro's 10-K results for the fiscal year ended March 27, 2026: total net sales $890,096 thousand, up 22.8% from $725,006 thousand; gross profit 46.3% of net sales (44.3% in fiscal 2025); purchases of property, plant and equipment $38,176 thousand (fiscal 2025: $39,955 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net sales $890,096 thousand (+22.8%); gross margin 46.3%; capex $38,176 thousand
